name: Helmsway
description: A restrained support site: a left-aligned search hero, popular articles with their first line and topic chips, then a compact topic list and contact.
features: Preset: help-centre, sections ordered popular → topics → contact
Popular articles: excerpt and topic chips, from the “Popular question” field
Popular topics as a compact list with counts
“Helped 93% of readers” under an answer once it has 20 votes
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

collections.name: Payments
collections.description: Accepting cards and wallets, declines, and refunds.

pages.title: Why was a customer’s payment declined?
pages.markdown: The card issuer decides, and most declines come back with a reason code — insufficient funds, a suspected fraud flag, or an incorrect security code. Open the payment in the dashboard to see the code and what the customer can do next.

pages.title: How long does a refund take to reach the customer?
pages.markdown: We send the refund to the card network straight away. Most customers see it on their statement in 5–10 business days; the exact time depends on their bank.

pages.title: Can I refund part of a payment?
pages.markdown: Yes. Open the payment, choose **Refund**, and enter an amount lower than the original. You can issue several partial refunds until the full amount is returned.

collections.name: Payouts
collections.description: When money lands in your bank account, and why it might not.

pages.title: When will I receive my payouts?
pages.markdown: Payouts follow your schedule — daily, weekly or monthly — once your first payout has cleared. The dashboard shows the expected arrival date for every pending payout.

pages.title: What should I do if a payout failed?
pages.markdown: A failed payout usually means the bank details are out of date. Update them under **Settings → Payouts**; we retry automatically with the new details.

collections.name: Disputes and fraud
collections.description: Responding to chargebacks and preventing them.

pages.title: How do I respond to a dispute?
pages.markdown: Open the dispute and choose **Submit evidence**. Include the receipt, proof of delivery and any messages with the customer. You have until the due date shown on the dispute.

pages.title: How can I reduce fraudulent payments?
pages.markdown: Turn on address and security-code checks, and add rules that block or review payments above an amount you choose. Rules apply to new payments only.

collections.name: Account and settings
collections.description: Verification, team access and tax details.

pages.title: Why do you need to verify my identity?
pages.markdown: Financial regulations require us to know who we pay out to. Verification usually takes a few minutes; we will email you if we need another document.

pages.title: How do I give a teammate limited access?
pages.markdown: Invite them under **Settings → Team** and choose a role such as **Support** or **Analyst**. Roles decide what they can view, refund or change.

pages.title: Where can I find my tax forms?
pages.markdown: Annual tax forms are under **Settings → Documents** once they are issued, usually by the end of January.

pages.title: Can Your Brand calculate tax at checkout?
pages.markdown: Yes. Turn on automatic tax under **Settings → Tax** and add the places you are registered. Each payment then includes the right rate for the customer’s address.
